name: Highlight Check
description: Flags highlighting that changes what a card says: a dropped "not" or "never", a dropped "rarely" or "seldom", half-read words and numbers, and more.
author: CardMirror

permissionReasons.doc.read: To read your cards and see which words are highlighted.
permissionReasons.doc.annotate: To underline suspicious highlighting, like spellcheck.
permissionReasons.ui.panel: To list every finding in one place.
permissionReasons.doc.events: To re-check as you edit, when you turn that on.
permissionReasons.files.data: To remember findings you chose to ignore, inside the file.
